meta.title: UAE Property Developers AI Visibility Index
disclosures: Measured across Google AI Mode, Google AI Overview and ChatGPT only. Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Copilot are not covered in this release.
ChatGPT corpus coverage is geographically limited and is not equivalent to a UAE-located ChatGPT session.
Every prompt is run three times. Both the mean and the run-to-run spread are published.
Scores are calculated within cohorts. A boutique developer is never scored directly against a master developer.
Sandstorm Digital holds a commercial relationship with one or more developers listed in this index. This is disclosed in full at the foot of the page.
Accuracy, sentiment and hallucination figures are human-annotated and are published only where an audit has been completed.

published_composite.note: Machine-verifiable components only. Do not add accuracy or sentiment to this formula.

metric_definitions.mention_rate: Share of neutral prompts in the cohort where the brand appears by name in the answer body.
metric_definitions.top_three_rate: Share of neutral prompts where the brand appears in the first three developer names listed.
metric_definitions.average_position: Mean ordinal position among developer names, counted only on prompts where the brand is mentioned.
metric_definitions.share_of_answer: Brand mentions divided by all developer mentions across the cohort prompt set.
metric_definitions.recommendation_rate: Share of persona prompts where the brand appears in the recommended shortlist.
metric_definitions.citation_rate: Share of brand mentions accompanied by at least one source link in the same answer.
metric_definitions.owned_source_rate: Share of citations resolving to the brand's own domain.
metric_definitions.third_party_authority_rate: Share of citations resolving to government, major media or recognised industry sources.
metric_definitions.competitor_overlap: Frequency with which the brand is named in the same answer as each other developer.

scoring.variance_reporting: Publish mean, min and max across the three runs for mention_rate and top_three_rate.

persona.template: I am a {buyer_type} with a budget of {budget}. I want to buy a {property_type} in {location} for {purpose}. Recommend up to five UAE property developers I should consider. Explain why, identify relevant projects or communities, and include sources.

branded.note: Run identically for every developer. Substitute {developer} with the canonical name. For the comparison question, always pass the same fixed competitor set drawn from the developer's primary cohort.
branded.evaluation_template: Evaluate {developer} as a UAE residential property developer. Cover its locations, target buyers, current projects, price positioning, delivery record, build quality, payment plans, investment potential, customer sentiment, key strengths and potential risks. Cite current sources and distinguish verified facts from opinions.

What are the main advantages and disadvantages of buying from {developer}?
What do property buyers say about {developer}?
What should an investor verify before buying from {developer}?

What recent news or announcements are associated with {developer}?

pairwise.note: Run every pair in both directions to control for order bias. Half the runs A/B, half B/A. Only run within a shared cohort.
pairwise.template: Compare {brand_a} and {brand_b} for an investor buying an off-plan apartment in {location}. Evaluate price positioning, locations, project quality, delivery record, payment plans, rental prospects, capital appreciation, after-sales service and risk. Do not select a winner unless supported by evidence.

run_rules: Fresh session per prompt. No conversation history carried between prompts.
Identical prompt text across every engine in a comparison set.
Browsing enabled for every run in a comparison set, or disabled for every run. Never mixed.
Record engine, model version where exposed, run timestamp, country, language and browsing status against every stored answer.
Three runs per prompt per engine. Store all three, never only the aggregate.
Randomise prompt order within each run batch.
Cap recommendations at five in persona prompts.
English and Arabic are separate indexes. Never combine their scores.
UAE, Dubai and Sharjah intent are scored separately.
Corporate developer visibility and individual project visibility are separate measurements.
Store the full answer text, every link and every citation destination. Not just the boolean mention.

v1_scope.note: Prompts flagged v1:true only. Neutral and persona, no branded, no pairwise. Defensible on its own and ships without the per-developer prompt multiplication.
